title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Rubber Materials
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Natural rubber is obtained from the milky liquid of a rubber tree called:
questions.explain: The milky fluid tapped from the rubber tree (Hevea brasiliensis) is called latex.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: The process of heating rubber with sulphur to improve its strength and elasticity is known as:
questions.explain: Vulcanization is the chemical process (discovered by Charles Goodyear) involving heating rubber with sulphur to make it harder and more durable.
questions.subject: Basic Technology
